title: Presentation deck editor
slide_intent: Carry brand structure into everyday authoring so consistency is practical for people making routine materials.
strategic_value: A recognizable slide framework can extend Channel 4’s identity beyond polished broadcast assets.
demonstration: A desktop slide-editor view shows a 2024 Trends / The future of TV slide with a photo, playful icons and a colored side panel.
practical_value: Compare the branded composition with the editing interface that surrounds it.

content_islands.name: Slide canvas
content_islands.spec: Keep the title and photo on white with a narrow colored information panel at right.

content_islands.name: Authoring context
content_islands.spec: Retain the slide thumbnails and application frame to show the material in use.

reference_purposes.Application: The case-study artwork shows a branded presentation slide inside an editor.
